title: GET /api/decks/images/tools (D1534, #3778 phase 2)
description: What the deck v2 adapter's `imageEditAi` method passes through (`deckImageEditsApi.liveTools`): the AI image tools and whether each can run here (`routes/deck_image_edits.ts`). Background removal (Bria RMBG 2.0 through AI Gateway) is on only while AI_PROVIDER_BRIA is exactly 'on'; Upscale has no model. Each tool says its model, its printed per-image price, and, when off, the words to show. Nothing is run or held. D1511 (#3762).
